title: ¶ On ſaynt Nicolas daye. The piſtle.

segments.text:
BEholde an excellent Preſte which in his dayes pleaſed God / & was founde righteous / & in tyme of wrath made an atonement: Lyke to him there is not founde / that kept the lawe of the mooſt hyeſt. And he was in covenaunt with him / & in his fleſſhe he wrote the covenaunt / & in tyme of temptacyon
he was foūde faythfull. Therfore he made him a covenaunt with an oth / that nacions ſhuld be bleſſed in his ſyght / & that he ſhuld be multiplied as y• duſt of the erth. He knew him in his bleſſinges & gave him an inheritaunce. And he kept him thorow his mercie / that he founde grace in the eyes of God. An everlaſtinge covenaūt dyd he make him / & gave him the office of ye hie preſte. He made him happie in glorye. In fayth & in his ſoftenes / he made him holy / & choſe him oute of all fleſſhe.
